name: specaitest

scripts.parse-document: sh -c 'set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && exec uv run python tools/parse_document.py "$@"' --
scripts.pipeline: sh -c 'set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && exec uv run python tools/run_pipeline.py "$@"' --
scripts.test:py: sh -c 'set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && exec uv run pytest "$@"' --

description: Generate and run browser tests from a local specification
